recap.headline: Waiver Wire Is Doing Everyone's Job
recap.subhead: Gopher Gold and BrookynDynasty are winning on pickups alone, and the rosters they drafted are decoration.

zingers.line: Strip out Dillon Brooks and Nolan Traore and BrookynDynasty loses 7-3 instead of leading 5-4; the draft room produced nothing here, the wire did everything.
Gopher Gold leads White Mambas 6-4 only because of Aday Mara, Collin Gillespie and Ja'Kobe Walter; without them it's 3-7, so the drafted roster is dead weight.
Suggs to be you cut Jrue Holiday, who has 32 points and 8 threes for Zero Fox Given since, and kept Jaylin Williams's 6 points.
Nova Knicks trail 5-4 while Naji Marshall's 10 assists and Caleb Wilson's 24 points sat on the bench; starting them ties it 5-5.

zingers.team: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw
zingers.line: Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw lead by one category with 23 starts left to Adam Silver Dez Nuts' 16; that lead is a formality.
MONSTARS ☄️ lost last night 8-1 to Zero Fox Given and has 15 starts left to their 19, with no punting strategy rescuing this.

night: Wendell Carter Jr. went 10-12 from the field for Suggs to be you with 27 points and 13 rebounds, and Nova Knicks lost the night 7-1.
Anthony Black gave theInfamous 10 points on 3-8 shooting; Stephen Curry's 29 points and 6 threes had to carry the whole damn building.
Davion Mitchell scored 22 on 9-18 shooting for BrookynDynasty, and that was the 'brick'. The night against LeParth James still ended 4-4-3.
Ryan Conwell put up 13 points, 3 threes and 3 steals on the free agent market, and he is still on the wire. Somebody was asleep.
Zero Fox Given won the night 8-1-2 against MONSTARS ☄️. Adam Silver Dez Nuts went 6-1-4 and still got buried by Da Don Da Beard & Da Klaw.
